items.source: Common configuration interface for transaction manager implementations. Provides registration facilities for TransactionExecutionListener.
items.translation: 事务管理器实现的通用配置接口。提供用于注册TransactionExecutionListener的设施。

items.source:
Conveniently register the given listener for begin/commit/rollback callbacks
from this transaction manager.
items.translation: 方便地为该事务管理器注册给定监听器，以处理开始/提交/回滚回调。

items.source: Return the registered transaction execution listeners for this transaction manager.
items.translation: 返回此事务管理器已注册的执行监听器。

items.source:
Set the transaction execution listeners for begin/commit/rollback callbacks
from this transaction manager.
items.translation: 从此事务管理器设置用于开始/提交/回滚回调的事务执行监听器。
